errors.claim: Leader role: 'takes responsibility for the work and development of people in the unit.'
errors.searches: rg 'responsibility for the work', 'development of.*people', 'work and.*development', 'role as a leader'
errors.source_check: Source (line 784) states the manager is 'responsible for the work of the people in their unit' and that this relates to 'their role as a leader.' The source frames the leader role around responsibility for the work, formal authority, and realized power (784-787); it does not say 'development' of people. 'Development' is a plausible element of Mintzberg's canonical leader role but is absent from this source text; grep for 'development of...people' found no supporting passage. Added element -> minor drift.
